# Openapi LLM Wiki

> LLM-optimized knowledge base for the Openapi® API marketplace (https://openapi.com):
> company profile, platform guide (OAuth v2, scopes, billing, sandbox, async patterns),
> API catalog, per-service endpoint references and the official OpenAPI 3 specs.

Load `platform-guide.md` together with any service page: it covers authentication and
billing, which every service shares. The full knowledge base in one file is at
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openapi/openapi-llm-wiki/main/llms-full.txt

## Core

- [Who is Openapi?](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openapi/openapi-llm-wiki/main/knowledge/company-profile.md)
- [Openapi services catalog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openapi/openapi-llm-wiki/main/knowledge/services-catalog.md)
- [Platform guide: authentication, scopes, billing, sandbox](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openapi/openapi-llm-wiki/main/knowledge/platform-guide.md)
- [Openapi Console FAQ](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openapi/openapi-llm-wiki/main/knowledge/faq.md)
- [References](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openapi/openapi-llm-wiki/main/knowledge/references.md)
